  • Comfortable neck padding to reduce strain during extended shoots
  • Adjustable length for a personalized fit
  • Sleek black design with a prominent Nikon logo for style and brand recognition
  • Secure attachment points to keep your camera safe

How to use

Attach the neck strap securely to the camera's strap lugs on both sides. Adjust the strap length to your preferred fit for comfort and ease of access. When not in use, store the strap in a cool, dry place to maintain its durability. Regularly check attachment points to ensure they remain secure.

Care instructions

Clean the strap with a damp cloth and mild soap if necessary, avoiding harsh chemicals that could damage the material. Allow it to air dry completely before storing. Avoid exposing the strap to extreme temperatures or prolonged direct sunlight to maintain its strength and appearance.
